product_backlog.title: State educator profiles
product_backlog.goal: Turn each state into a useful research page, not only a resource filter.
data_sources: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics for state teacher pay by occupation
Official state education agencies for standards by subject and grade band
NAEP State Results for comparable grade 4 and grade 8 subject trends
NCES National Teacher and Principal Survey for statistically valid working-condition and satisfaction measures
guardrails: Show the occupation, year, median or percentile, and source beside salary figures; add cost-of-living context later rather than implying that nominal pay is directly comparable.
Distinguish full NGSS adoption, standards influenced by the Framework, and state-specific science standards using official state documentation.
Prefer scores, trends, participation notes, and uncertainty over a single reductive state ranking.
Do not invent a teacher-happiness score; label the underlying survey measures and only publish estimates that meet NCES reporting standards.
product_backlog.next_action: Use the sourced Virginia prototype to add states in repeatable batches, preserving occupation definitions, assessment caveats, and working-condition reliability checks.

product_backlog.title: Repair and quality-check the state map
product_backlog.goal: Make every state recognizable and reliably interactive in both map and list views.
data_sources: Albers USA projection with explicit Alaska and Hawaii insets
guardrails: Preserve multipolygon states and islands instead of treating every state as one continuous shape.
Add visual regression checks for Alaska, Hawaii, Michigan, Maryland, and other geometry edge cases.
Keep the accessible state list as an equivalent navigation option.
product_backlog.next_action: Maintain visual checks for Alaska, Hawaii, Michigan, Maryland, and other multipolygon states when the display geometry is refreshed.

product_backlog.title: Teacher usefulness and usage signals
product_backlog.goal: Help teachers see which resources have been tried and found useful without turning the catalog into a popularity contest.
data_sources: Teacher-submitted 'used this' and 'was this useful?' signals
Optional contextual rating fields such as grade band, subject, and implementation setting
Privacy-respecting aggregate visits to official resource links
guardrails: Show response counts and distinguish clicks, saves, classroom use, and ratings.
Use minimum-count or Bayesian treatment so one early rating cannot dominate discovery.
Add duplicate-abuse controls and collect the least personal information possible.
Require moderation before allowing public written reviews.
product_backlog.next_action: Prototype a low-friction 'I used this' and 'helpful' interaction, define the privacy model, and test ranking behavior before enabling public ratings.

status_definitions.indexed: A repeatable importer captures the current official item-level catalog.
status_definitions.partial: Useful records or doorways are present, but the underlying collection is not yet fully indexed.
status_definitions.queued: The official source has been identified and is ready for an importer or structured review.
status_definitions.needs_access: The preferred official interface requires a key or other owner-provided access.
status_definitions.temporarily_unavailable: The official source could not be reliably reached during the latest verification pass.
status_definitions.planned: In scope, but scheduled after higher-priority classroom-resource sources.
